title: Create a customer reservation

narrative.soThat: the customer receives a confirmation number

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given valid reservation details, when the associate submits the reservation, then a confirmation number must be generated and the reservation status is CONFIRMED.
The start date must be earlier than the end date.
The customer count must be greater than zero.
An approved payment method is required.
Customer first name, last name and email are required.
The number of customers must be at least one.
